body.p: offers a plugin that integrates an AI Positron pane for AI-assisted documentation writing. By leveraging the power of AI platforms, the AI Positron helps you write and refine content with AI-based actions, chat, and response refinement tools.
For information about the AI Positron pane and its features, see AI Positron Pane (Web Author).
For installation and configuration details, see Oxygen AI Positron for Web Author.
